home.title: Write; let who, where and when link themselves.
home.lead: Kenet is a personal journal that needs no account and keeps everything in plain Markdown files. It links the short entries you write during the day to people, places and time on its own, in a vault Obsidian can open.
home.storeBadgeSoon: Coming soon to the App Store
home.phoneAlt: Kenet Today screen: day and week strip, masthead line, goals, tasks and the quick entry field
home.howTitle: You write. Kenet links the person, place and time.
home.mechFileNote: It is written to your day file as plain Markdown. When a name is ambiguous the app asks; it does not guess.
home.promise1Body: Markdown is the source of truth, and there is no account. You can read the files without the app. A vault in iCloud Drive or in a folder you picked stays if you delete the app; on iPhone and iPad, a local vault on the device is deleted with the app.
home.promise2Body: Kenet writes to the file first, then updates its index. It never touches text it does not recognise. Deleting asks or can be undone.
home.promise3Body: The vault is the same as Obsidian's. No app-specific syntax, and the vault is not encrypted.
home.screensTitle: The screen you open every day stays simple; detail lives in the other tabs.
home.screenPersonTitle: A person's history on one page
home.screenPersonCaption: Last meeting, that day's people and places. With calendar access, upcoming events show here; you can add the birthday from the date in the person's file to your calendar.
home.screenPersonAlt: Kenet person page: last-seen chart, the day's entry, the person and place from that day, Show in Graph button
home.screenPeopleCaption: Graph and map entries, people you have not seen in a while, and the people list.
home.screenPeopleAlt: Kenet People and Places screen: Graph and Map entries, people you have not seen in a while, and the people list
home.screenKanbanTitle: Tasks on a Kanban board too
home.screenKanbanCaption: Tasks with project tags in status columns; the same tasks as a list and a timeline too.
home.screenKanbanAlt: Kenet Tasks Kanban view: task cards with project tags in status columns
home.screenGoalCaption: Type the amount on the number pad, add a quick step or complete the goal. Below: chain, last 90 days and heat map.
home.screenGoalAlt: Kenet goal detail: a large amount field on a daily water goal, +1 and +2 quick add, a Complete to goal button, chain, last 90 days chart and heat map
home.tabletAlt: Kenet on iPad in landscape: sidebar, journal calendar and the Today screen; goals, tasks and calendar events
home.tabletCaption: On iPad the sidebar, the list and the page sit side by side. Open a past day and its entries and tasks gather in time order on a single Schedule card.
home.vaultTitle: The same vault as Obsidian. No export.
home.vaultNote: SQLite is only an index; these files are the source of truth.

home.closingPlatformMac: Mac: reaches the store after iPhone and iPad.
